name: Shotgun - Z Tight Right - 38 Toss

QB.rule: Hand the ball to the tailback as he crosses in front of you, then fake a run to the left.

TB.rule: Cross in front of the quarterback, take the handoff going right and get to the edge behind the fullback. Turn up outside his block.

coaching_points: The handoff happens in front of the quarterback: the tailback crosses close and flat, and the quarterback puts it in his belly.
The tailback stays behind the fullback until the block is made, then turns it up. Running past his blocker is how the sweep loses yards.
The quarterback's fake to the left has to be real. It is what holds the backside.
